title: `CErc20.sweepToken` Uses Raw `token.transfer` Without Return-Value Handling
impact: `token.transfer(admin, balance)` on a non-standard token (no return value, e.g. USDT-like) will revert under Solidity 0.8 ABI decoding of `bool`, or silently succeed on false-returning tokens. This bricks the admin's ability to sweep accidentally sent tokens. Less severe since it only affects admin recovery, but it's inconsistent with `doTransferOut`'s careful handling.
